Meet the Gerenuk, the incredible 'giraffe gazelle' of East Africa! 🦒✨

This unique antelope stands up to 105 cm tall and weighs between 18 and 52 kg. It is famous for its long slender neck and reddish brown saddle.

Have you ever seen an antelope with a neck this long before?
